kjv: visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children
mine: bringing the iniquity of the fathers on the children
note: poqed avon means to bring the consequences of iniquity to account; "visit" in this punitive sense is now obscure.

kjv: break their images, and cut down their groves
mine: smash their standing stones and cut down their Asherah poles
note: matsevot are cultic stone pillars and asherim are wooden cult objects (poles or stylised trees) associated with the goddess Asherah, not groves of trees.
charish is plowing; "earing" (from Old English erian, to plow) is now misread as the time of ears of grain.

mine: because he (Moses) had been talking with him (Yahweh)
note: bedabbero ito can be temporal or causal; the shining resulted from Moses' speaking with God, and he was no longer talking at the moment of descent.

kjv: till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face
mine: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face
note: vaykhal Moshe middabber means "Moses finished speaking"; he veiled himself after delivering God's words (34:34-35), not while speaking as the KJV's supplied "till" implies. Relevant to Paul's use in 2 Cor 3:13.
